svg.title: SENTILEX — architecture
svg.desc: SENTILEX: Explainable network intrusion detection · XGBoost · SHAP · FastAPI · React. Intrusion detectors usually say "attack" without saying why. SENTILEX classifies network flows, shows which traffic features drove each alert, writes a plain-English explanation and checks it before proposing a simulated response.
